source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Look at the failed inspections.
3. Get the completed fire-safety checklists for the failed inspections.
   - These are typically long PDF documents.
   - Find the section on "Fire Alarm Systems -- General".
4. Look at the "fire alarm system start switches" to see if there are any failures.
   - Locate the "fire alarm system start switches" items on the form(s).
   - Count each failure.
   - If there were multiple failures of the same type, count them seperately each.
<eos>
